scripts.check: node --test && node --input-type=module -e "import { readdirSync } from 'node:fs'; import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process'; for (const dir of ['src','test']) for (const file of readdirSync(dir).filter(f => f.endsWith('.mjs'))) execFileSync(process.execPath, ['--check', dir + '/' + file]);"
